summary: Tested the rebuilt Fitness Anatomy Trainer (Expo + three.js) end-to-end. Backend GLB endpoint /api/anatomy/model returns 200 with valid GLB magic and ~5.6MB binary. Frontend: app loads directly to Explore tab (no auth), 3D ecorche renders in a WebGL canvas, all expected testIDs are present and interactive. Explore (zoom-in-btn/zoom-out-btn/reset-view-btn/anatomy-viewer/cat-*/toggle-skeletal/toggle-muscular/show-all-btn), Workout (cat-Push/Pull/Legs/Core, ex-squat tap updates workout-ex-name to 'Barbell Back Squat' and recolours model), Muscle Info (muscle-search filters list, info-Biceps_Brachii opens MuscleSheet with muscle-detail-title + muscle-detail-close), and Settings (About + How to use) all functional. Shrink View slider/normal/full work after segment switch. No console errors; only benign WebGL perf warnings and a React-Native-web pointerEvents prop-deprecation warning.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/explore.tsx:52 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/workout.tsx:38 (legend also uses pointerEvents='none')

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace `pointerEvents='box-none' / 'none'` JSX prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Old Apex AI server.py is large (~1500 lines) and still serves auth/workout/coach routes that the anatomy app no longer uses. Consider moving the anatomy endpoint into a dedicated module and trimming dead routes once the rebuild is confirmed.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (set in frontend/.env). All testIDs requested in the spec are present.
seed_data_creation: None required (no auth, anatomy data is static).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo public convention). The shrink-normal/shrink-full testIDs are conditionally rendered — only visible after switching the segmented control to 'Shrink View'. 3D tap-to-identify uses three.js raycasting on the canvas; verified indirectly via Muscle Info tab which opens the same MuscleSheet component with the correct muscle-detail-title / muscle-detail-close testIDs.
